item.title: recomended additons
item.content:encoded:
this is awesome, but there is important field codes that need added, especially since I am planning on using these

additions that are needed, symbols will need added by someone else but here is what they need to mean

+ show block
– hide block

Use explosives liberally

restrict use of explosives

don't use explosives

poison air (bio-hazard)

Poison air (unexplained)

no air

leave door closed

Plague

friendly anomaly

they can smell your blood (cover open wounds… if not fall back to a secure area, and keep it secure.)

not worth it (give up, fall back, but ensure all units are with you when you do, call in appropriate airstrike to clense area upon return to base)

Give up (SCP will cooperate if task force is not a threat or threatening… think Carefully before use)

do not contain (attempts to contain agitate anomaly, leave it alone and secure area for field research team if doing so can be done safely and if field commander has ruled anomaly is safe enough to study.)

Melee only (use of bare hands are surprisingly effective against anomaly, if parred with no guns assume non firearms weapons are just as useless as guns in this case)

feel free to add others.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Very cool bit of foundation world building. It stands to reason there would be established, rudimentary systems of communication given how often anomalous zones interfere with technology.

My only criticism, which isn't so much a criticism as a "I'd love to see more" sort of point, is it's a bit too utilitarian. Symbols like "do not follow the little girl" stand out to me far more than any of the practical symbols, because it establishes this almost comedic precedent that the Foundation routinely encounters anomalous little girls that lead their MTFs and Agents astray. Like, it happens so often it necessitates a symbol. Pray while shooting is another good example of this. I'd have loves to see more along these lines (pun not intended).

Either way, nice work! +1

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
That's awesome to hear they have made it to your wall irl. I've had people discuss working them into different stories or mediums, some interesting comment short fiction written on Reddit. Only really recently have I seen them brought up more than just sharing the original.

Some Chinese producers made listings on Amazon with the symbols on shirts. An SCP game included one as an Easter Egg. Fans made joke edits or their own symbols. I finally cleaned up the image and made listings for shirts and posters myself. Now BoneWorks has several of the symbols in the game and I'm trying to make sure they properly credit me for the originals.

It's been an interesting ride since I first posted these on dA and on the wiki forums.

item.content:encoded:
Thought it might be time to finally give these their own home on the wiki since they've done a trip around the internet and several satellite fandoms since originally being posted to the forums back in 2013.

To attribute to this tale:

_ is based on "SCP Field Codes" by "Toadking07": http://www.scp-wiki.net/SCP-Field-Codes

After some feedback way back when I made the Wanderer's Symbols their own page. Wasn't sure they'd stand the test of time on the wiki, but people liked them enough to make them my most upvoted article on here. Cheers to embracing the field codes in all their forms!
